verdict.rationale: Ironclad's API clearly supports launching contract workflows from templates, tracking through approval/signature, and webhooks for status updates (docs-5, docs-13, docs-23, docs-38, docs-46), which covers the 'route for signature end-to-end via API' half of the story. However there is no evidence of an MCP server, and no documented API endpoint for AI-driven drafting of contract text (the 'Ironclad AI' page is marketing copy, not an API spec) — an agent would have to rely on generic template/record APIs rather than a documented drafting capability. missing for 10: MCP server, documented AI-drafting endpoint/API for generating NDA text.
